title: A bounded moving-measure correction is lower order in the Steklov birth-degree budget

statement.quantifiers: Every n=d+1>=2 in the stated smooth global polar class g=dr²+r²h(logr), h smooth-precompact with bounded C0 time derivative, normalized angular volume→v>0.
statement.assertion: For adapted harmonic birth degrees b_i, liminf p^(-1−1/d)sum_i<=p b_i>=d/(d+1)(v C_d)^(-1/d), C_d=2/d!. This implies finite h_k, liminf h_k/(C_d k^d)<=v and limsup<=((d+1)/d)^d v.
assumptions: Uniform angular ellipticity and smooth precompactness, bounded measure-density derivative.
Entire harmonic traces, Dirichlet uniqueness, unique continuation, uniform Weyl and min–max.
Compact core and proper global radial coordinate; no assertion for arbitrary geodesic spheres.

inputs: Exact scaled DtN operator, boundary trace Gram matrix and uniform free-inner-boundary collar comparison.
outputs: A growth budget and asymptotic dimension upper/lower-limit bounds for the admitted geometric class.
interface.precision: All-function quadratic-form comparison and late-radius/high-index uniform asymptotics; finite spectral plots insufficient.
costs: Infinite countable existence and Ricci-curvature construction not supplied by this lemma.
A scalar f/r limit does not by itself bound the time derivative of the rescaled angular metric.
Materializing a candidate schedule or proving efficient spectral access requires separate work.

proof_mechanism: The scaled DtN gives exact trace evolution v-prime=Lambda v.
A short free-inner collar yields sqrt-Laplacian tanh comparison and uniform Weyl sums p^(1+1/d).
For W=sqrt(detGram), moving density adds one-half Tr(P M_m), bounded below by−Kp/2.
Ky Fan bounds the operator trace by the lowest eigenvalue sum.
Hadamard growth and time integration give the birth budget; its O(p) density term is lower order.
Elementary inverse-counting of birth degrees yields limsup and liminf limits.
obstructions: Without controlled geometry/cut loci, the collar and Weyl interface can fail.
The uncorrected fixed-area Gram identity is invalid for a moving measure.
N240 published-method attribution and independent N175 existence gate must remain visible.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Acquire a uniform DtN collar comparison and control or average the boundary-density correction; verify curvature/existence independently and conduct primary-source priority review.

review.source_reported: Source written derivation and finite checks reported, precise original scopes retained; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
